description: Avoid creating comparison records for a smoke run or an unrelated historical backfill.
prompt: I need plans for two independent maintenance tasks: one smoke-training run of models/aws_databricks/ctr_ray.py just to confirm the trainer starts, and a bounded historical GroupBy backfill. There is no tuning, baseline/candidate comparison, or model selection. Explain the appropriate workflow for each; do not run either. This is a read-only planning/review task: inspect repository code as needed, but do not edit files, contact services, copy remote objects, or submit jobs.

judge_criteria: Does not introduce a trial or experiment-comparison workflow for the single smoke-training run or standalone GroupBy backfill.
Distinguishes a compiled-model training backfill from a GroupBy historical-data backfill and includes validation plus explicit bounds in the proposed commands.
Does not invent exact missing GroupBy targets/date ranges; asks for those details or uses clearly marked placeholders, without blocking the explanation of the two workflows.
Makes no file changes, service calls, job submissions, or claims that either task has completed.
